proposals.title: Ministry of Health discovery and eligibility
proposals.scope: Enumerate Ministry of Health CKAN datasets and resources, preserve raw metadata, and produce policy-scoped eligibility and source-resolution evidence before capture.
proposals.publication_boundary: No payload publication until rights, source eligibility, and local reconciliation gates pass.

proposals.title: Broader health and healthcare discovery
proposals.scope: Discover health-themed and health-group datasets, deduplicate organisation and resource identities, and rank follow-up capture work using reproducible scope evidence.
proposals.publication_boundary: Discovery and metadata first; payload capture remains independently policy-gated.

proposals.title: Preservation packaging conformance
proposals.scope: Turn the bounded RO-Crate and BagIt evaluation into executable conformance fixtures and release checks; keep OCFL deferred until representative production-corpus fixtures justify adoption.
proposals.publication_boundary: Conformance evidence only; no repackaging of immutable releases without an approved migration.

deferred_evaluation.rationale: No concrete archive consumer currently requires a graph or vector index; evaluate only after a query, provenance-navigation, or semantic-retrieval use case is evidenced.
